name: KYC Governance & Policy
description: Board-approved KYC policy, ML/TF risk assessment, designated officers, KYC audit.

name: Customer Acceptance & Onboarding
description: Account opening decisions, acceptance criteria, rejection handling, financial inclusion.

name: Customer Identification & CDD
description: Identification of individuals, proprietary firms and legal entities; document capture.

name: Digital & Remote Onboarding
description: V-CIP, OTP-based e-KYC, digital KYC, non-face-to-face onboarding.

name: Beneficial Ownership
description: Identification of natural persons owning or controlling non-individual customers.

name: Customer Risk Categorisation
description: Low/medium/high rating, parameters, periodic review, confidentiality.

name: Transaction Monitoring & ODD
description: Ongoing due diligence, alert generation, unusual and structured transactions.

name: Periodic KYC Updation
description: Re-KYC cycles, intimations and reminders, BC-assisted updation, acknowledgements.

name: Enhanced Due Diligence
description: PEPs, non-face-to-face customers, high-risk jurisdictions, professional intermediaries.

name: Sanctions & Prohibited Persons Screening
description: UAPA Sec.51A, WMD Act Sec.12A, UNSC lists, freezing and reporting.

name: Regulatory Reporting — FIU-IND
description: CTR, STR, NTR, CCR filing; confidentiality; no account restriction on STR alone.

name: Records & Data Management
description: Retention periods, retrievability, CKYCR upload, DARPAN registration, secrecy.

name: Fraud Risk Governance
description: FRM policy, SCBMF, natural justice, whistle-blower, organisational structure.

name: Early Warning Signals & Red Flagging
description: EWS design, CBS integration, alert TAT, RFA decisioning, CRILC reporting.

name: Fraud Investigation & Classification
description: Audit of red-flagged accounts, 180-day cycle, SCN and reasoned order, group accounts.

name: Fraud Reporting — LEA & RBI
description: FMR filing, LEA thresholds, nodal officers, CFR and CPFIR, closure.

name: Staff Accountability & Penal Measures
description: Time-bound accountability exams, ABBFF referral, borrower debarment.

name: Branch Operations & Instrument Handling
description: Cheque and forged instrument frauds, instrument validity, physical security incidents.

name: Credit Administration Controls
description: Legal audit of title documents, transfer of accounts to ARCs, third-party accountability.

name: Assurance & Internal Audit
description: Concurrent audit, internal audit coverage of KYC and fraud processes, auditor escalation.

name: Credit Risk Governance & Policy
description: Board-approved credit risk policy, credit risk management architecture, delegation of powers.

name: Credit Exposure Limits
description: Single borrower and group borrower ceilings, large exposure framework, substantial exposure.

name: Credit Risk Evaluation & Appraisal
description: Credit appraisal standards, internal rating, due diligence, sanction and review.

name: Capital Adequacy — CET1 / AT1 / Tier 2
description: Regulatory capital composition, eligibility criteria, deductions, minimum ratios.

name: Risk-Weighted Assets Computation
description: Standardised and internal-ratings approaches for credit, market and operational risk.

name: ICAAP & Stress Testing
description: Internal capital adequacy assessment, scenario design, Board oversight of stress results.

name: Capital Buffers (CCB / D-SIB / CCCB)
description: Capital conservation, domestic systemically important bank and countercyclical buffers.

name: Leverage Ratio
description: Exposure measure, tier 1 leverage ratio computation and minimum requirement.

name: Pillar 3 Market Discipline & Disclosure
description: Prescribed disclosure templates, frequency, medium and Board attestation.

name: Country Risk Management
description: Country exposure limits, country risk categorisation and provisioning.

name: Unhedged Foreign Currency Exposure
description: UFCE data collection, incremental provisioning and capital add-on.

name: Legal Entity Identifier
description: LEI capture and renewal for borrowers above prescribed exposure thresholds.

name: Valuation of Properties & Empanelment of Valuers
description: Valuer empanelment criteria, revaluation frequency, independence of valuation.

name: CERSAI Filing
description: Registration and satisfaction of security interest with the central registry.

name: Credit Concentration & Sectoral Limits
description: Sectoral, industry and counterparty concentration ceilings and monitoring.

name: Securitisation & Credit Risk Transfer
description: Capital treatment of securitisation exposures, significant risk transfer tests.

name: Unclassified — needs manual assignment
description: Placeholder for requirements whose business area has not yet been reconciled.
